semantics: Base44 entity names are migration inputs, never runtime dependencies.
Rows marked retired are excluded from active charging inventory.
Observed usage remains observed evidence and may bind spatially or by station_external_id.
Awarded or planned infrastructure is market/pipeline evidence, never operational charging inventory.
Missing values remain null/unknown and are never normalized to zero.
Live public-source layers migrate as owned adapters, not copied stale tables.

EVOpsTariff.guardrail: Tariff record is candidate context until service-point assignment is verified.

RivetUtilityProgramEvidence.guardrail: Program/rate evidence is not site eligibility, tariff assignment, funding award, or observed utilization.

WashingtonNEVIAwardSite.guardrail: Awarded pipeline is not operating infrastructure.

US-WA:utility_service_area.semantic_guardrail: Screening boundary only. Confirm actual service with utility.
